en: <t1>Where they go.</t1> The trunk is the remote's default branch as <t2/> reads it (<t3/>); a checkout is on it when <t4/> is the local branch of that name (<t5/>). There, <t6/> writes each new candidate to <t7/>, and <t8/> and <t9/> write the closed session record to <t10/>, instead of the tracked sections. The outbox is checkout-local and never tracked, so closing an episode on the trunk leaves <t11/> empty. A candidate whose id is already promoted or superseded is skipped as before, and one already tracked with the same bytes is reported <t12/> and is not staged. A repository with no remote, or no remote default branch, and a detached <t13/> are not on a trunk: there the records go where they always have.

Tam <t6/> zapisuje každého nového kandidáta do <t7/> a <t8/> a <t9/> zapisují záznam uzavřené relace do <t10/> místo sledovaných sekcí. Outbox je lokální pro checkout a nikdy se nesleduje, takže uzavření epizody na trunku nechá <t11/> prázdné. Kandidát, jehož id je už povýšeno nebo nahrazeno, se přeskakuje jako dřív, a ten, který už je sledován se stejnými bajty, se hlásí <t12/> a není staged. en: The audit of repository entry (<t1/>, measured 2026-09-10) found what the two decisions had never been made to agree on. The lease lives at the checkout root, the root is the nearest <t2/>, every worktree has one, and the identity a probe compares is a digest of that root. So "one server per repository" was one server per <t3>checkout</t3>: a linked worktree elected its own server on its own port with its own peer board, and no reading of any lease said that two such servers belonged together. A session in one worktree could not see the peers of another, <t4/>'s peers section read the primary's board from a worktree by guessing at the primary's path, and the mandate's worktree scenario — same repository, distinct worktrees, peers that can tell the scopes apart — was not failing; it was unreachable.

Relace v jednom worktree neviděla peery jiného, sekce peerů v <t4/> četla nástěnku primárního checkoutu z worktree hádáním cesty k primárnímu a scénář worktree z mandátu — stejný repozitář, odlišné worktree, peeři, kteří rozliší rozsahy — nebyl selhávající; byl nedosažitelný.

en: The server keeps the index it built at start; a client that attaches later sees the layer as it was then, and rediscovery is a restart (the server ends when the last client leaves). Na <t3/> není žádný stream iniciovaný serverem, žádné oznámení, žádný odběr. Lease je na checkout: dva worktrees mají dva servery. <t4/> nelze zachytit, takže ponechává lease dalšímu procesu k převzetí; klient HTTP, který odejde bez <t5/>, udrží server, jehož vlastník už odešel, naživu nejvýše devadesát sekund.
